setting.note: Three generations of the al-Jawad family live out Egypt's early-twentieth-century upheavals within a few crowded lanes of medieval Cairo, in the al-Gamaliya quarter around Bayn al-Qasrayn, the great al-Husayn mosque and the bazaars. The whole trilogy turns on a handful of real streets a walker can still trace.
